1de97fd5: What is the name of the series' main guild?
Fairy Tail is the most famous guild in Fiore, known for its powerful wizards but also for its collateral damage.
390811a2: What type of magic does Natsu Dragneel use?
Natsu is a Fire Dragon Slayer, trained by the dragon Igneel.
587d4337: Who trained Natsu as a Dragon Slayer?
Igneel, the Fire Dragon King, taught Natsu Fire Dragon Slayer Magic before disappearing on July 7.
afed0761: What is Lucy Heartfilia's special power?
Lucy is a Celestial Spirit Mage who summons celestial spirits using Gate Keys (gold and silver).
a6d8d7d6: Who is the master of the Fairy Tail guild?
Makarov Dreyar was Fairy Tail's 3rd, 6th and then 8th master. He is also one of the Ten Wizard Saints.
e4424d86: What is the real name of Titania, the Queen of the Fairies?
Erza Scarlet is nicknamed “Titania” (Queen of the Fairies) because of her extraordinary power and commanding personality.
9ec0e315: What is the name of Gray Fullbuster's magic?
Gray uses Ice-Make, a molding magic that lets him create objects and weapons out of ice.
5e127475: Silver Fullbuster, a former member of Tartaros, turns out to be Gray's late father, brought back to life by Keyes.
b099393f: What is the name of the iron dragon who trained Gajeel?
Metalicana, the Iron Dragon, trained Gajeel Redfox as an Iron Dragon Slayer before disappearing.
04e2c4a4: What type of Slayer Magic does Wendy Marvell use?
Wendy is a Sky Dragon Slayer, trained by the dragon Grandeeney. She uses wind to heal and to fight.
1adbfb5f: What is the name of the enemy guild in the Tenrou Island arc?
Grimoire Heart, the dark guild led by Hades (Precht), invades Tenrou Island to seize Zeref.
13379ecb: Who is Zeref Dragneel to Natsu?
Zeref is Natsu's older brother. He used his knowledge of dark magic to bring Natsu back to life as an Etherious.
51f545b1: What is Fairy Tail's final story arc?
The final arc pits Fairy Tail against the Alvarez Empire, led by Zeref, with Acnologia as the ultimate threat.
4bb012a9: What is the name of Fairy Tail's first master?
Mavis Vermillion is the founder and first master of Fairy Tail, nicknamed the Fairy Tactician.
35dd1ebb: Which spell does Fairy Tail use to protect Tenrou Island?
Fairy Sphere is an absolute defense spell cast by Mavis that protects Tenrou Island for 7 years.
55fced1b: Laxus is a Lightning Dragon Slayer thanks to a lacrima implanted in him. He is Master Makarov's grandson.
bcf76195: Arc of Time lets Ultear manipulate the time of objects and living beings, moving their state forward or backward.
25c9d55a: What is the name of the black dragon, king of dragons?
Acnologia is the Dragon King of darkness. Once human, he bathed in the blood of dragons until he transformed.
2f489e33: Who leads the Sabertooth guild in the Grand Magic Games arc?
Jiemma Orland is Sabertooth's cruel master. He expels and humiliates members who lose.
59f89676: E.N.D. (Etherious Natsu Dragneel) is the most powerful demon from the Books of Zeref. It is Natsu himself, brought back as an Etherious.
68c1e82a: What type of magic does Cana Alberona use?
Cana uses Card Magic. She is also able to use Fairy Glitter, a legendary spell.
2f277033: Who is Cana Alberona's biological father?
Gildarts Clive, Fairy Tail's most powerful wizard, is Cana's father. He did not know he had a daughter until she told him.
dda17c9a: Which dark guild do the heroes face in the Nirvana arc?
Oración Seis is a dark guild led by Brain/Zero. It seeks to activate Nirvana, a destructive magic.
00578f88: What is the name of Sting Eucliffe's dragon?
Weisslogia, the White Dragon, trained Sting as a White Dragon Slayer before being killed by him.
81a47337: What is Mirajane Strauss's unique ability?
Mirajane uses Take Over, especially Satan Soul, which lets her take on the form and powers of demons.
47ffce97: Which legendary spell can only be used by Mavis?
Fairy Heart is the infinite magic power stored in Mavis's body. Zeref wanted to use it to destroy Acnologia.
dad9d9b7: What is the name of the independent guild founded by Jellal, Ultear and Meredy to fight dark guilds?
Crime Sorcière is founded by Jellal, Ultear and Meredy, repentant former enemies who hunt down dark guilds.
dceb507c: What is the name of Fairy Tail's sacred island?
Tenrou Island is Fairy Tail's sacred island, site of the S-Class trial and where Mavis's body rests.
b21debb1: What is Gray's most powerful spell as a Devil Slayer?
Ice Devil's Zeroth Long Sword is a devastatingly powerful ice sword that Gray masters in Devil Slayer mode.
aec41056: What is special about Ultear's time magic, Last Ages?
It rewinds a minute at the cost of her life
Last Ages lets Ultear turn back time by one minute, at the cost of all her remaining life. She ages instantly.
c9ea4039: What is the name of the blue cat who travels with Natsu?
Happy is Natsu's Exceed (a winged cat). He can fly and means a great deal to Natsu.
d3b2b22e: In which arc does Fairy Tail travel to a parallel world?
The Edolas arc sends Fairy Tail's members to a parallel dimension where magic is a limited resource.
fa0b602c: What is the name of Fiore's capital?
Crocus is Fiore's capital and the venue of the Grand Magic Games. Magnolia is the town where Fairy Tail is based.
8b3bbb46: What is the name of Laxus's group within Fairy Tail?
The Thunder God Tribe (Raijinshū) brings together Freed, Bickslow and Evergreen, Laxus's loyal companions.
73657dee: Gajeel Redfox is the Iron Dragon Slayer, a former member of Phantom Lord who joined Fairy Tail.
92694b3a: Freed masters Jutsu Shiki runes, which let him create restriction zones, barriers and traps.
7d14ba80: Natsu is nicknamed “Salamander”, after the fire creature. It is the name he is known by all over Fiore.
abd8ded7: Who leads the Lamia Scale guild?
Ooba Babasaama is Lamia Scale's master. Lyon Vastia and Jura Neekis are two of its best-known wizards.
87eee0b6: What is the name of the continent where Fairy Tail takes place?
Ishgar is the name of the eastern continent of Earth Land, where the Kingdom of Fiore lies and where most of the story happens.
94c8a778: What is the power of August, son of Zeref and Mavis?
August is nicknamed the “Wizard King” because he can copy and use any magic he has seen once.
34532f2d: What is the name of the fairy-like friend attached to Mavis in her youth?
Zera is Mavis's childhood friend. We later learn that she was only an illusion created by Mavis herself.
c84744ae: Which empire does Zeref rule under the name Spriggan?
The Alvarez Empire, a vast empire west of Ishgar, is ruled by Emperor Spriggan, who is none other than Zeref.
6ef44036: What is the name of Wendy's Exceed companion?
Carla (or Charle) is Wendy's Exceed. She can see the future and is the daughter of the Exceed Queen.
7066ecc2: What is the name of Gajeel's Exceed companion?
Pantherlily is Gajeel's Exceed. A former captain of Edolas's army, he can take a large, humanoid battle form or a small one.
a54bf783: What is the true name of the curse that afflicts Mavis?
Ankhseram's Curse strikes anyone who tries to manipulate life and death. Zeref and Mavis are both its victims.
51ba95d0: Gildarts masters Crash, a magic that shatters anything he touches, matter or magic.
3678a239: What is the name of an event held during the Grand Magic Games?
Hidden is one of the events of the Grand Magic Games, in which wizards must find targets hidden among copies in a town.
bb8937df: What is the name of Zeref and Mavis's real son?
August is Zeref and Mavis's secret son — nicknamed the “Wizard King”, he can copy and use any magic he observes.
c69d49f8: What is the name of Brandish μ's magic that changes sizes?
Command T is Brandish's magic — it can enlarge or shrink anything to an astronomical scale, including whole islands.
aa1574a6: Who is the author of the Fairy Tail manga?
Hiro Mashima published Fairy Tail from 2006 to 2017 in Weekly Shōnen Magazine.
1b101d15: In which town is the Fairy Tail guild?
Fairy Tail is based in Magnolia. Crocus is the capital of the Kingdom of Fiore.
72f86f3f: In which kingdom does most of Fairy Tail take place?
The Kingdom of Fiore is on the continent of Ishgar.
3933b06c: Which species does Happy belong to?
Happy, Natsu's winged blue cat, is an Exceed, like Carla and Pantherlily.
97d0186b: Which celestial spirit is hiding under the identity of Loke, a Fairy Tail member?
Loke is actually Leo, leader of the Zodiac spirits, banished to the human world. He becomes Lucy's spirit.
1adc2c26: What is the name of Erza's magic that lets her change armor in an instant?
With Requip, Erza changes armor and weapons in the middle of a fight.
ea5c2e7d: In which tower was Erza held as a child?
As a child, Erza was enslaved to build the Tower of Heaven, where she met Jellal.
8abe607f: Which item did Natsu receive from his adoptive father Igneel?
Natsu never takes off the scaled scarf Igneel left him.
3eba9676: What bad habit does Gray Fullbuster have?
Used to training in the cold, Gray takes his clothes off without even realizing it.
747e7015: Which guild did Juvia Lockser come from before joining Fairy Tail?
Juvia, a water wizard, was part of Phantom Lord, the rival guild that attacks Fairy Tail.
ca2a427a: Who leads the Phantom Lord guild?
Jose Porla, master of Phantom Lord, starts the war against Fairy Tail out of jealousy.
c830387d: How many years do Fairy Tail's members stay frozen on Tenrou Island?
Protected by Fairy Sphere, the wizards stay frozen for seven years. When they come back, Fairy Tail has become the weakest guild in Fiore.
c639c186: Which guild wins the Grand Magic Games?
Back after seven years away, Fairy Tail wins the Grand Magic Games and becomes Fiore's top guild again.
85726354: What is the name of Lucy's father?
Jude Heartfilia, a wealthy businessman, hires Phantom Lord to bring his daughter back. Layla is Lucy's mother.
d12cc5a2: What are the names of Mirajane's brother and sister?
Mirajane, Elfman and Lisanna Strauss all master Take Over magic.
00d85617: What is the official sequel to Fairy Tail called?
“Fairy Tail: 100 Years Quest”, written by Hiro Mashima and drawn by Atsuo Ueda, follows Natsu and his friends on the hundred-year quest.
c16c7bdc: As the Iron Dragon Slayer, Gajeel feeds on iron and metal.
31908664: Who was Gray's teacher in his childhood?
Ur, an ice wizard, trained Gray and Lyon. She sacrificed herself to imprison the demon Deliora.
